meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Rumble ad cards and sponsored videos; blur or hide thumbnails, hide live viewer counts, category rows, followed channels
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, rumble.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): ad containers `rac-ad-*` 2 plus the mobile ad container 1, sponsored cards 1 (the card's link goes through the ads.rmbl.ws network), video thumbnail pictures 169, live watching counters 10 plus the live viewer counter 1, category rows 1, followed channels 50 (menu items with live dots), menu footer 1. Rumble uses Lit web components (`rum-video-thumbnail`, `rum-videos-row-provider`) with stable tag names; generated `rum-xxxxxx` classes are never used alone.

NOT verified: video pages (comments, related list), the desktop layout, channel and search pages, signed-in states, cookie consent (none appeared), the original app-banner rule. Hide on thumbnails removes only the picture so the card link and title stay.
